features.feature: Read ledger summaries without changing gates (Touchpoint 5 preamble)
Derive totals via the summary identity (inputTokens+outputTokens+cacheCreationInputTokens+cacheReadInputTokens), not from a stored total
Grouped aggregation by storyId, phase, agentType/role, model, provider
Provider-reported vs prompt-size-estimate vs unavailable kept separate in aggregation
Unknown/unavailable stays unknown (never 0) in aggregation
Superseded estimates excluded from final usage totals
Cost derived only in a layer that pins model+date to a versioned price table via pricingRef (no absolute dollar amount on record)
Cost projection uses an INJECTED price table (per-model $/MTok including cache multipliers); no hardcoded prices
Cost is null/omitted when no price table is supplied (not 0)
pricingRef/pricingVersion recorded when a price table is supplied
Unknown token dimensions -> cost unknown (never treated as 0)
Surface unknown or unavailable usage as unknown (not zero) in the report
Read-only report builder that feeds no gate (no gate/verdict/decision/blocker field; not imported by any handler/gate)
Avoid model-routing or optimization advice in the first diagnostics slice
Runnable reporter entry-point (reads ledger JSONL path, optional price table, prints report, human + JSON mode)
Reporter wired as an npm script, NOT a registered lattice CLI command
Smoke/test suite covering grouped aggregation, cost projection, report shape (no gate field), reporter task runs, build green, zero-cross-module-import assert
No regression in the other usage-ledger smokes
Ledger schema and writer (Touchpoint 1: JSONL schema, writer choke-point, runtime artifact registry, hash chaining)
